mapper.sql: id, social_provider, provider_user_id, email, nickname, social_name, profile_image_key, name, status, difficulty_id, tutorial_seen_at, group_tutorial_seen_at, personal_mission_unlock_status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user (social_provider, provider_user_id, email, social_name, status, difficulty_id) VALUES (#{socialProvider}, #{providerUserId}, #{email}, #{socialName}, #{status}, #{difficultyId})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_user SET personal_mission_unlock_status = CASE WHEN personal_mission_unlock_status = 'UNTRACKED' AND relative_mission_qualified_at IS NULL THEN 'INSUFFICIENT' WHEN personal_mission_unlock_status = 'INSUFFICIENT' AND relative_mission_qualified_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE personal_mission_unlock_status END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE tbl_user SET personal_mission_unlock_status = 'SEEN' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND personal_mission_unlock_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE tbl_user SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = #{withdrawnAt}, email = NULL, nickname = NULL, social_name = NULL, name = NULL, phone = NULL, birth_date = NULL, gender = NULL, profile_image_key = NULL, provider_user_id = CONCAT(provider_user_id, '_withdrawn_', id) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
